result: Fixed a current HTTP/2 correctness bug discovered during the read-only residual performance review. No throughput measurement or performance conclusion.
bug: StoredHeader interleaved FieldRef metadata and HttpHeader view, but regular_headers/trailer_headers exposed the view member as a count-element contiguous span. Elements after the first had the wrong stride.
fix: Keep metadata array and truly contiguous HttpHeader array in the same original allocation. alignas(HttpHeader) aligns the second array; checked capacity multiplication preserves OOM handling. Construct and destroy both arrays for each successful allocation, including partial initialization failure.

allocation_change.calls: Unchanged: one headers allocation and one trailers allocation per stream.
allocation_change.maximum_capacity: Unchanged: limits.max_header_count for each array; no lazy growth or cold allocation optimization.
allocation_change.supported_64bit_layout: FieldRef=12B, metadata=24B aligned to8, HttpHeader=32B: both formulas56B/slot. Default128slots=7168B per header/trailer block. No per-stream pointer or field added.
allocation_change.layout_basis: Derived from current supported 64-bit type layout/source; not a runtime allocation/RSS census.

verification.build: Fresh GCC14/O3 before+candidate HTTP2 product TU and shared fresh test TU, directly linked existing nghttp2/foundation/http objects and gtest. No configure, SDK copy/download, or foundation rebuild.
verification.before: Same new regression fails with original product source, exit1; no crash.
verification.candidate: All14 current tests pass (13IoHttp2+1feature). Forced epoll regression passes.
verification.coverage: Both directions: 2custom regular headers plus typed content-length, 2trailers, full range iteration/content; regular view remains stable across incremental body reads and later trailer HEADERS; trailer view remains stable across final acknowledgement/read.
verification.limits: No Windows/macOS run, no sanitizer, no forced HEADERS/CONTINUATION packet split or per-allocation fault injection, no timing.

cleanup: Only exact remote files in cleanup-candidates.json; root owns test.ps1 cleanup. No deletion performed.
